name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
text: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP). Credit-linked subsidy program to generate self-employment micro-enterprises in non-farm rural sectors. Target Categories: Food Processing, Manufacturing, Handicraft, Repair & Services. Eligibility: {"min_age": 18, "min_education": "8th Pass for manufacturing > 10 Lakhs", "new_project_only": true} Required Docs: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Project Report (DPR), Educational Qualification Certificate, Category/Caste Certificate (if applicable), Rural Area Certificate from Tehsildar.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
text: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME). Provides financial, technical, and business support for micro food processing enterprises under One District One Product (ODOP). Target Categories: Food Processing, Livestock & Dairy, Agriculture. Eligibility: {"individual_or_group": "Individual micro food processing units", "one_district_one_product": "Preferred alignment with ODOP crop"} Required Docs: Aadhaar Card, FSSAI Basic Registration, Bank Statement (Last 6 Months), Proof of Ownership/Lease for Premises, Detailed Project Report.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
nodal_agency: Department of Financial Services / MUDRA Bank
text: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY). Collateral-free micro financing for small businesses across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun loan buckets. Target Categories: Digital Services, Retail, Repair & Services, Livestock & Dairy, Handicraft. Eligibility: {"collateral_free": true, "target_group": "Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises"} Required Docs: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID / Driving License, Business Address Proof, Quotation of Machinery / Items to be purchased, Bank Statement (Last 6 Months).
required_documents: Quotation of Machinery / Items to be purchased

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (Micro Enterprise Support)
text: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (Micro Enterprise Support). Subsidized interest loans and revolving funds for SHG-affiliated women entrepreneurs embarking on micro-enterprises. Target Categories: Handicraft, Food Processing, Livestock & Dairy, Agriculture. Eligibility: {"target_group": "Self-Help Group (SHG) members and rural women entrepreneurs", "repayment_track": "Good credit history in SHG"} Required Docs: SHG Membership Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passbook of SHG Bank Account, Micro-Investment Plan (MIP).

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
nodal_agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF). Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. Target Categories: Agriculture, Food Processing, Agriculture & Services. Eligibility: {"target_group": "Agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies"} Required Docs: Aadhaar / PAN Card, Land Ownership / Lease Records, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Bank Account Details.
